parts:
Dear Maaslin users, 

Sorry to bother you again. Using either http://huttenhower.sph.harvard.edu/galaxy or http://huttenhower.org/galaxy, it would appear that the Maaslin file format is no longer available. Did you encounter the same problem ?
See attached screenshots.

Thank you in advance, 

Camille

messages.author: 0e7e2c402c0cbfe6
messages.subject: Re: MaAsLin file format
parts:
Hi Camille and Alessandro,

I have been able to use MaAsLin in Galaxy by allowing it to auto-detect the file format; if you then refresh the MaAsLin window (just click on it again in the menu on the left) it should detect your .pcl file.

Cheers,
Rachael
